title: The Qutb Minar's Five Storeys

segments.say: At seventy-two point five metres, the Qutb Minar in Delhi is the tallest masonry tower in India.

items.text: lightning; Firuz Shah Tughlaq rebuilds the top as two storeys

segments.say: Qutb ud-Din Aibak began it around eleven ninety-nine, but finished only the first storey. His successor, Iltutmish, added the second, third and fourth.
In thirteen sixty-nine, lightning struck. Firuz Shah Tughlaq rebuilt the damaged top, splitting it into two smaller storeys. That is how the tower came to have five.
Built of red and buff sandstone, it is carved with bands of inscriptions, and has balconies for the call to prayer.

right.title: Alai Minar
items: only a 25 m first storey stands

segments.say: Nearby stands a stump. Alauddin Khalji planned the Alai Minar at twice the Qutb's scale, but only its first storey, twenty-five metres high, stands.
The complex also holds the Quwwatu'l-Islam mosque, the Iron Pillar, the tomb of Iltutmish and the Alai Darwaza. UNESCO listed it in nineteen ninety-three.
For GS One, remember the builders in order: Aibak, then Iltutmish, and Firuz Shah Tughlaq for the top.

sources: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Qutb Minar and its Monuments (whc.unesco.org/en/list/233): red and buff sandstone, inscriptional bands, tallest masonry tower in India at 72.5 m, balconies for the call to prayer; Quwwatu'l-Islam mosque, Iron Pillar, tomb of Iltutmish, Alai Darwaza; the incomplete Alai Minar, planned at twice the scale, stands 25 m (first storey); inscribed 1993

Wikipedia, 'Qutb Minar' (read): Aibak began construction around 1199 and finished only the first level; Iltutmish erected the second, third and fourth storeys; in 1369 lightning struck and Firuz Shah Tughlaq reduced the fourth storey and separated it into two; five storeys; damaged by an earthquake in 1505 and repaired under Sikandar Lodi

quiz.q: Who built only the first storey of the Qutb Minar?
quiz.why: Aibak began it around 1199 and finished the first level.

quiz.q: How did the Qutb Minar come to have five storeys?
options: After lightning in 1369, the top was rebuilt as two storeys
It was built with five from the start
quiz.why: Firuz Shah Tughlaq split the damaged fourth storey into two.

quiz.q: The unfinished Alai Minar was begun by…
quiz.why: UNESCO: Alauddin Khilji's expansions included the incomplete Alai Minar.
